item.title: David Gilmour sold his guitars for $21.5 million to fund climate change and nature protection work
item.description: In June 2019, David Gilmour sold over 120 guitars, significantly benefitting ClientEarth with the proceeds. Among them was the iconic 1969 Fender Stratocaster, which achieved a record sale price. These funds were dedicated to advancing environmental law initiatives aimed at combatting climate change. This remarkable auction intertwined rock legacy and ecological activism, illustrating Gilmour's commitment to fostering a sustainable future through music. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Wildfire smoke shuts schools in Amazon's biggest city
item.description: The largest city in the Brazilian Amazon, Manaus, closed public schools on Friday as smoke from hundreds of wildfires blanketed the metropolis amid an intensifying El Niño event. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Hunger and malnutrition stalk Gazans, a year on from ceasefire
item.description: Every day, Gazan mother Niyaha al-Masri spends six exhausting hours or more queueing at a community kitchen in the hope of getting some food for her family. It has been a year since a ceasefire between Hamas and Israel was supposed to allow food to flood into the ruined territory, yet widespread hunger persists there. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Climate crisis is coming to crush many of world’s best surf breaks, study warns
item.description: Changing tide levels, shifting sands and hardened shorelines put waves at risk, affecting more than just surfers The climate crisis is coming for some of the world’s greatest surf breaks, submerging some as sea level rises and wiping out others as classic breaks get crushed against coastal developments. Analysis of dozens of famous waves in world surfing reserves (WSR) found more than three-quarters were at high risk because of changing tide levels, hardened shorelines and shifting sands. item.description: Two powerful 7.7 and 6.6 magnitude earthquakes and a series of aftershocks struck Panama on Friday afternoon, collapsing buildings near the epicentre and prompting evacuations across the country, the US Geological Survey said. The earlier quake, felt as far away as neighbouring Colombia, was centred about 10km (six miles) southwest of the remote community of Pitaloza Arriba, in the central province of Herrera, the USGS said. item.title: Un fuerte terremoto de magnitud 7,7 sacude Panamá
item.description: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,6 ha sacudido Panamá este viernes, según el Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS), y ha desatado el pánico en la capital de los rascacielos. El seísmo ha activado también la alerta de tsunami, que ha sido posteriormente retirada.El USGS ha informado inicialmente de una magnitud de 8, pero la ha rebajado poco después a 7,6, y ha ubicado su epicentro a 10 kilómetros de Pitaloza Arriba, en el centro sur del país. Poco después se han producido réplicas de 6,1, 6,0 y la más reciente de 5,3.Aunque inicialmente no se reportaron daños estructurales de relevancia, sí… Publicado también por: ABC España - Internacional, Noticias Telemundo. item.title: Ranch Relisted After Wildfire: Turkey Track returns at $180 million; restored Texas Panhandle giant
item.description: Turkey Track Ranch, a storied expanse in the Texas Panhandle, is back on the market with a price tag of $180 million after extensive revitalization. Initially listed before the 2024 Smokehouse Creek Fire altered much of its landscape, this 77,721-acre haven now boasts restored wildlife and thriving cattle operations. Featuring essential resources like irrigation pivots and mineral interests, it stands poised for a new investment venture. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,6 sacude el centro y el sur de Panamá
item.description: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,6 ha sacudido Panamá este viernes, según el Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS), y ha desatado el pánico en la capital de los rascacielos. El seísmo ha activado también la alerta de tsunami, que ha sido posteriormente retirada.El USGS ha informado inicialmente de una magnitud de 8, pero la ha rebajado poco después a 7,6, y ha ubicado su epicentro a 10 kilómetros de Pitaloza Arriba, en el centro sur del país. Poco después se han producido réplicas de 6,1, 6,0 y la más reciente de 5,3.Aunque inicialmente no se reportaron daños estructurales de relevancia, sí… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.description: When the COVID-19 pandemic brought human activity to a standstill around the world in the first half of 2020, wildfire incidents also declined by more than 12%. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: Storm expected to make landfall on US’s northern Gulf coast with risk of flash floods and isolated river flooding Isaias has become the first Atlantic hurricane of the 2026 season, with wind speeds of 80mph and a minimum pressure of 975mb.
